name: Henkankaishi.  －Konmei－
source:
-If your name is tweeted, you will die-

Monolog is an SNS where you can post tweets of up to 150 characters on the Internet..
An unidentified garbled account suddenly appeared in the monolog..

The account tweeted the names of their classmates one after another..
With a death notice saying "I'm going to die".

Then, the death threat became a reality, and before I knew it, many of my classmates had died..

Is there any way to help?.
Why are they killed?.

What is the unidentified account with garbled characters?.

The beginning of fear and despair.
Reveal its true identity.
translation:
-如果你的名字被推特，你就会死-

Monolog是一个SNS，你可以在互联网上发布最多150个字符的推文。
独白中突然出现了一个身份不明的乱码账号。

该账号纷纷在推特上发布了他们同学的名字。
死亡通知书上写着“我要死了”。

然后，死亡威胁变成了现实，不知不觉间，我的很多同学都死了。

有什么办法可以帮忙吗？
他们为什么被杀？

不明账户乱码是什么？

恐惧和绝望的开始。
揭露其真实身份。
